name: Leo Howard Memorial Bursary (UQ)
summary: Bursary for early-stage full-time UQ engineering students who can show financial hardship.
who: Enrolled full-time in the BE(Hons), BE(Hons)/Master of Engineering, or an engineering dual.
how: Apply using the online application portal with a cover letter, resume, mySI-net studies report and evidence of financial hardship.
catches: The value is set each year by the Associate Dean (Academic).

source.label: UQ Scholarships: Leo Howard Memorial Bursary

evidence.quote: The Associate Dean (Academic) will determine the value of the scholarships each year.
